name: Essence from the Vale

date.label: Original World of Warcraft Classic quest-chain scene; in-world date unknown

summary: The task turns from harbor dust to the green shade of Feralas. The bramble is used to capture the spirits of three Vale Screechers, as the quest requires; this is a repeated objective, not proof that three named individuals met in one event. Their gathered essence gives Yeh'kinya evidence to interpret, but it does not yet reveal what he means to do with it.
